status: Candidate preview ready for user review; visual acceptance and historical validation remain pending
source: Exact captured CharacterKit and CharacterAnimation snapshots; actual indexed geometry; original unit scale 1.0; CPU software raster, not GPU.

rendering.lighting: offline ambient and Lambert key/fill; sRGB conversion; projected source-triangle shadows, not runtime GPU evidence

visuallyVerifiedImprovements: Jagged horizontal waist boundary is gone; maid robe now reads as a continuous garment.
Rounded crown is visible from front, side and rear; low bun is behind head in side/rear views.
Shoulder background gaps no longer visible in examined views.
Seated and standing palms overlap visually.
Cuff lining and forearm continuity have improved; background no longer shows through examined seated cuff.
Nose and lips no longer appear clearly detached in 90 degree side view.
remainingVisualGaps: Faces, neckline, hem, ears and low bun retain visible low-poly facets rather than reference-level semi-realism.
A few short temple-hair edges remain simplified.
Hands are more articulated but less naturally relaxed than reference; overlapping-finger silhouette still simplified.
Cloth folds, facial modelling and detail density remain stylized; do not call this semi-realistic reconstruction.

rendererSafetyTests.scope: Actual non-mutating triangle raster and overwrite rejection. No full repository/GPU suite run by renderer worker.

userReference.role: User-provided visual/art-direction target only; not a historical source and not a gameplay screenshot.
userReference.outputMethod: Reference was visually inspected; final preview is rasterized actual CharacterKit geometry, not a copy or generated re-creation of the reference image.
